Class QwenVlProcessor

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.model.qwen.QwenVlProcessor
public class QwenVlProcessor extends Object
HuggingFace-compatible image/video preprocessor for Qwen3.8 native VLM.

Produces packed patches, grid metadata, expanded chat token ids, and interleaved mRoPE position planes.

      public QwenVlProcessor(QwenVisionArgs visionArgs, Tokenizer tokenizer, int patchSize, int temporalPatchSize, int mergeSize, int minPixels, int maxPixels, double[] imageMean, double[] imageStd, double defaultVideoFps, int videoMaxPixels)
      Creates a VL processor for chat tokenization and vision preprocessing.
      Parameters:
      visionArgs - vision / token id config.
      tokenizer - chat tokenizer.
      patchSize - spatial patch size.
      temporalPatchSize - temporal patch size.
      mergeSize - spatial merge size.
      minPixels - smart-resize min pixels.
      maxPixels - smart-resize max pixels.
      imageMean - normalize mean (RGB).
      imageStd - normalize std (RGB).
      defaultVideoFps - default video sampling fps.
      videoMaxPixels - video smart-resize max pixels.
